title: Gradient field
description: A soft moving background: big gradient orbs drifting, an aurora of wide colour bands, or floating bokeh, with an optional dot grid and film grain. Opaque; put text or UI blocks over it.

style.description: orbs: large soft blobs; aurora: wide flowing bands; bokeh: many small out-of-focus lights.

colors.description: Orb colours as #rrggbb (empty: the palette's accent, secondary and tints).

speed.description: Drift speed (1 = one slow loop in about 10 s).

dots.description: A fine dot grid over the field, fading at the edges.

grain.description: Subtle animated film grain (hides gradient banding).
